content.comment_body: Good afternoon forum, I'm trying to program a text display that will be connected to a [product_name] [article_no]. However, when I change the configuration in the [product_name] software to [article_no] standard, the text display disappears. Is there any way to access text and cursor functions?
Hello [user_name], Have you seen this [url]: Compatibility overview of [product_name] modules. Could you clarify what you want to achieve? Best regards,

If the program was created for a [article_no], and then you switch the hardware selection to [article_no], text display features disappear because the functions available differ between these versions.
I have a [article_no] device and a [article_no] text display. I need to show some warning messages, like activating a warning when an input is triggered.

analysis.insight_summary: Users observed that configuring a text display with a [product_name] module of a certain version using [product_name] software leads to unavailable text display features when changing hardware selection from a newer module to an older one. It appears some text and cursor functions are unsupported in specific hardware versions, highlighting inconsistencies in feature compatibility across different versions.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects consistent access to text and cursor functions for text displays on both newer and older [product_name] module versions when programming with [product_name] software.
